title: Review a pull request as a guided, complete argument
statement: As a reviewer, I can review a pull request as a guided visual argument with complete code coverage, so that I can make and revisit decisions with the right context.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each pull request has at most one review deck.
A review deck follows the pull request's current base and head.
The review deck explains what changed and why.
A review item can link to the product documentation it changes.
A reviewer can approve, request changes on, or clear a decision for each slide.
Each slide decision records the reviewed head revision.
Review comments can target a slide or one of its items.
A slide decision becomes out of date when the slide changes.
A slide decision becomes out of date when its linked code changes.
The review coverage view identifies every changed line not explained by an item.
The product records individual review decisions without declaring the pull request approved.
A merged review remains available from the documentation it changed.
